credit.name: Sri Venkata Satya Sai Eswar Moparti
credit.note: Bioinformatics graduate student who is the creator and developer of VisualMD, responsible for the software's conceptualization, architecture, implementation, development, testing, and documentation. Developed VisualMD as a local-first molecular dynamics visualization and analysis workspace for computational biology and structural bioinformatics.

description: visualmd is a local-first workspace for exploring molecular dynamics simulations. It links an interactive 3D protein viewer (Mol*) to trajectory analyses (RMSD, RMSF, radius of gyration, residue contacts, DCCM, PCA, free-energy landscapes, secondary structure and more), so that features in a plot can be related to the corresponding conformations. Figures, data and portable sessions can be exported, including PNG and MP4. Runs on the user’s own machine, with no data uploaded. Linux x86_64 preview release, free to use but not open source.

documentation.note: Official technical documentation for VisualMD, covering its architecture, installation and setup procedures, supported molecular dynamics formats, available analysis modules, workflow, configuration, and usage instructions. Serves as the primary reference for users installing and working with VisualMD.

download.note: Prebuilt Linux x86_64 distribution of VisualMD, packaged as a compressed TAR archive (.tar.gz). Contains the application files required for local installation and execution.

link.note: Official GitHub repository of VisualMD, containing the application source code, installation instructions, documentation, development updates, and issue tracking. Provides access to the software's implementation and release information.
